reader_agreement.wrist_ball_note: the 8.43 cm ball is kept unchanged (a2-consistency-0650-decision-20261023): a conservative necessary bound for larger violations, not a wrist-feasibility check and not a fix for the observed misses. A forecast it flags has a hand origin no MuJoCo pose of this arm can have; one it does not flag is NOT shown feasible. Where it flags none, this reading adds zero value and zero gradient, so on such examples it makes no wrist-learning contribution; none is demonstrated
reader_agreement.swing_note: the term's elbow reading (the swing, from |M n - n|) divided by the reader's off-axis length; 1 = the same; below 1 where the elbow angle is large (the reader's rotation-vector measure grows with the on-axis turn)

coefficient_screen.what: THE EXACT PER-EXAMPLE FINAL-LAYER COMPARISON on SAVED-OUTPUT PROXIES: for one example b with final-layer input h_b != 0, each term's weight gradient is g_b h_b^T and its bias gradient g_b, so |g_geo_b| / |g_sup_b| and the cosine of g_geo_b and g_sup_b are the ratio and cosine of the whole final layer's gradients (h_b cancels). g at the raw output, through the real scaling and composition, the gaze row masked, the mean reductions and HORIZON_WEIGHTS of the lesson; the term per unit weight (efference_weight x term). Exact for the outputs supplied; the outputs are saved proxies, so the historical-input claim is not exact
does_not_recover: earlier layers (body_mlp.0, body_mlp.2, body_pool, body_all, lat_norm)
the minibatch sum's ratio and cosine

lesson_route.proxy: SAVED-OUTPUT PROXY: the stored expectation eff_exp (the head's tenure output formed where each command began, from that moment's latent and weights, stored float16) stands in for the tenure re-forward the lesson grades (the same stored latent, re-forwarded 5 model steps of head updates later); not an exact replay of the historical lesson-time outputs

planner_route.note: selected forecasts with the measured 250 ms change (decision__achieved to end_pose) as the target: the planner's forecast outputs, a saved-output proxy, not the lesson's own grading

rule.bounds_exactly: at the selected weight the final-layer geometry pull is at most half the supervised pull for 90% of the screened lesson-route proxies; the tail (10%), the minibatch-summed gradient, the earlier layers and the optimizer's effect are not bounded by this rule
rule.no_eligible_meaning: NO_ELIGIBLE_WEIGHT: no series value meets the line; the lesson stays disabled

update_mechanics.label: MECHANICS CHECK on explicitly synthetic valid head inputs (exact FK start and end poses of the compiled a2 scene, commands toward the end pose, random latents): not a replay of the 72 historical examples and not a movement benefit. It updates the body head's parameters only, without the efference group's gradient clip (the clip's shared scope is reported in S5)

balance_measurement_tensor_bytes.accounting: two float32 gradients over the body head's parameters, their two float64 flattened copies, and two [B, H, 12] output gradients with their float64 copies; all transient (freed when the measurement returns); autograd's own buffers not counted

cost.note: CPU; the trainer's card times differ; the lesson's own time is logged as efference_ms; no speed claim follows from these numbers. Bounded by the cadence: at most BALANCE_MAX (10) measured gradings per launch
